The '''2023 Retro League Event 3''' was the third event of the [[2023 Retro League]] on [[GEMP]] (4 June – 16 July 2023), played in [[Premiere - Death Star II]] format.<ref name="t82165" /> [[Paul Todd Feldman]] won.

== Format ==
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Site:''' [[GEMP]]
* '''Dates:''' 4 June – 16 July 2023
* '''Players:''' 60 (in the posted standings)
* '''Winner:''' [[Paul Todd Feldman]]
